source.method: owner-official firmware extraction, serial-TFT trace, static bridge review, and official manual cross-check

candidate_architecture.physical_ui: unchanged Comgrow serial TFT firmware and layout
candidate_architecture.bridge_boundary: unprivileged vendor bridge talks only to the serial TFT and the loopback compatibility gateway
candidate_architecture.moonraker_boundary: Mainsail talks directly to loopback-only Moonraker; the physical bridge talks through the compatibility gateway
candidate_architecture.principle: a display or bridge failure must not restart Klipper, alter safety limits, or interrupt an active print

dispositions.preserved: The candidate performs the action advertised by the stock control.
dispositions.translated: The advertised action is preserved through a named compatibility macro or object alias.
dispositions.local: The TFT or bridge handles this control without a printer command.
dispositions.explicitly_refused: The candidate reports that the action is unavailable; it must never report false success.
dispositions.constrained: The action remains available inside a disclosed safety boundary.
